about_the_game:
🚀 Boost your speed with instant mouse teleportation between portals!

Mouse Portal: Teleport Your Cursor lets you place colorful linked squares on your screen that act as instant teleporters for your mouse. Hover, click, or drag — your cursor will jump between portals in a flash. Both fun and surprisingly useful, it’s like giving your mouse a sci-fi upgrade.

🔑 Core Features

🌀 Add unlimited Portals

  • Place pairs of colorful portals anywhere on your desktop.

  • Each pair is uniquely colored so they never get mixed up.

🎯 Teleport Instantly

  • Hover your mouse for 250ms on one portal and instantly appear at its partner.

  • Or left-click a portal for an immediate teleport.

  • No accidental ping-pong: teleport only once until you exit the portal area.

🖱️ Smart Controls

  • Right-click a portal to delete its pair instantly.

  • Drag portals anywhere on screen while lock is disabled.

  • Shift + F1 hotkey Add a new portal pair at your cursor.

  • Tray icon left-click also adds a portal pair (auto-adjusted away from taskbar).

🗂️ Save & Load Automatically

  • Save all your portal placements and restore them automatically next time you start the app.

⚙️ Customizable Settings

  • 🔒 Lock/Unlock: Freeze portals or make them pass-through for clicks.

  • 👁️ Hide/Show: Toggle portal visibility anytime.

  • 💧 Transparency: Adjust portal opacity in real-time.

  • 📐 Portal Size Slider: Resize all portals

💻 Lightweight & Non-Intrusive

  • Runs quietly in the system tray.

  • Easy to Use

✨ If you want to speed up your workflow, reduce mouse travel time Mouse Portal makes it fast, simple, and efficient.

Mouse Portal brings a unique, interactive twist to how you use your computer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 1 GHz processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 520 / AMD Radeon R3
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz or faster processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550 or higher
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • VR Support: Not supported
